article.headline: Games To Watch: Unbeaten Pass Christian, West Harrison girls meet on the Coast
article.html:
Pass Christian and West Harrison bring unbeaten girls soccer records and defenses that have yet to concede in their posted results into Wednesday’s meeting in Gulfport. The Pirates visit the Hurricanes at 5:30 p.m. CDT on October 28, giving the Coast doubleheader an opening matchup between two sides coming off clean sheets.

Girls soccer: unbeaten starts meet at West Harrison

Pass Christian enters 1–0, while West Harrison is 2–0–1. Their nonconference match gives each a chance to test that start against another team with a win already recorded and no defeat. West Harrison has the longer opening record; Pass Christian brings a perfect one from its only posted result.

The most recent wins offer a clear point of comparison. Pass Christian beat Pascagoula 4–0 on Monday, October 26. West Harrison beat Hancock by the same score Tuesday, October 27, scoring all four goals after a scoreless first half. Both arrive from shutout wins, but West Harrison’s came just the previous evening.

The season totals make the defensive test more compelling. Pass Christian’s current record shows four goals scored and none allowed. West Harrison’s shows six scored and none allowed across its three recorded results. Tonight offers a direct comparison between attacks that have already produced goals and defenses that have kept every reported opponent off the scoreboard.

Boys soccer: a first win is available after narrow losses

The boys match follows at 7 p.m. CDT, also at West Harrison. Pass Christian enters 0–1 and West Harrison 0–1–1, so both are seeking their first victory in the posted season records. The contrast with the girls match is clear: the opening game tests unbeaten starts, while the later game offers a chance to move beyond an opening stretch without a win.

Neither side was far away in its most recent result. Pass Christian lost 1–0 to Pascagoula on Monday; West Harrison lost 3–2 to Hancock on Tuesday. Those one-goal margins give this meeting a more useful frame than the winless records alone: each has a recent close result to improve upon when the teams meet tonight.
